basic_info.description: Rarely available Unit 1907 offers the premier 2BD/2BA floor plan in the most desirable stack at the Bridgeview, the premier luxury high-rise in South Beach. Wake up to breathtaking East & South facing water views from every room, including a private balcony off the primary suite. Recently updated with wide-plank flooring, new carpet, fresh paint, new lighting, each rooms has custom closet organizers, and turn-key home also includes in-unit laundry and assigned storage. The chef's kitchen is appointed with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and abundant cabinetry, opening to a light-filled living space framed by large picture windows. Elevated amenities include deeded parking, a fitness center, heated lap pool and hot tub, 24/7 front desk security, and a rooftop sundeck with BBQ area for panoramic Bay views. Perfectly located near the waterfront, residents are steps from the Embarcadero, Oracle Park, the Ferry Building, and world-class dining and shopping, with easy access to the Chase Center, Caltrain or BART, and major freeways. Experience the best of San Francisco living at Bridgeview.
